Student.title: Student
Student.description: Represents a student in the academy.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Student entity.

instructorId.description: Reference to the Instructor (User). (Relationship: User 1:N Student)

status.description: The membership status of the student.

paymentStatus.description: The payment status of the student.

bodyMeasurements.description: The student's body measurements in centimeters.

notes.description: Instructor's notes or observations about the student.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Attendance entity.

date.description: The date of the attendance record.

present.description: Indicates whether the student was present.

Payment.title: Payment
Payment.description: Represents a payment made by a student.

id.description: Unique identifier for the Payment entity.

paymentDate.description: The date the payment was made.

User.title: User
User.description: Represents a user of the application, who can be an instructor or an administrator.

id.description: Unique identifier for the User entity, matches Firebase Auth UID.

email.description: The email of the user, used for login.

isAdmin.description: Flag to determine if the user has administrator privileges.

Workout.title: Workout
Workout.description: Represents the weekly workout schedule for a single instructor.

schedule.description: The workout schedule, mapping days of the week to time slots and student names.

/students/{studentId}.description: Stores student data. Instructors can only access students linked to their ID.

/students/{studentId}/attendance/{attend.description: Stores attendance records for each student.

/students/{studentId}/payments/{paymentI.description: Stores payment history for each student.

/users/{userId}.description: Stores user data, including instructors and administrators. The document ID is the Firebase Auth UID.

/workoutSchedules/{instructorId}.description: Stores the weekly workout schedule for each instructor. The document ID is the instructor's UID.
